# awgit

> Semantic version control on top of git — edit-ops and leases.

Several agents editing one worktree silently sweep each other's work; a diff tells you WHAT changed but not who meant it or whether they were mid-edit.

## Install

```
pip install awgit
```

## In Claude Code

- mcp: `awgit mcp`

## Use it in 30 seconds

Take a lease on a file before you edit it in a shared checkout.

## Composes with

- [awgraph](https://aitherium.github.io/awgraph/) — A semantic code graph for agents — AST + tree-sitter, call graphs.
- [awrelay](https://aitherium.github.io/awrelay/) — Portable agent messaging — findings, alerts, coordination.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awgit
- Docs: https://aitherium.github.io/awgit/
- Manifest (keys + the one-line adoption story): https://aitherium.github.io/awgit/aither-manifest.json

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awgit.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
